meta.source_provenance: Email from Ben Carter to PC Jon Dixon on 16 Dec 2024 at 22:43 (provided by user)

emails.subject_summary: Follow-up on music misuse relevance to stalking case
emails.body:
Just thought as you're building a case against her and posting a song about someone online they're on bail for stalking charges would be relevant to the case?
I know you can't update me, so I don't know what's going on, but if you feel this is irrelevant or you have enough stalking evidence already then no problem.
I don't know the law or how it applies to this case only you do. I'll let you know whenever something comes up though I just hate not knowing and now know there's been accusation against me. It's horrible.
Thanks Ben
